The '''Ytha'ac system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="XWvTF" /> located within the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Ytha'ac Cluster/Legends|Ytha'ac Cluster]].<ref name="XWvTF" />
